title: VTC Booking — Busy — Put — payload
description: The host's agent supplies the host's busy time to their booking page: merged, quarter-hour-widened intervals at most ninety days ahead, replacing the last supply. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

intervals.description: The whole set; it replaces the last. Empty withdraws it (VTI-CAL-060).

Response.title: VTC Booking — Busy — Put — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/booking/busy/put/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/booking/busy/put/0.1#response.

intervals.description: How many intervals are held now.
